data.rationale: The proposal matches the true goal and step order (open hotel search, destination with suggestion, dates, guests, search, filters and sort), and it names the needed parameters. It adds children and ages and a fixed sort of price low to high, and it leaves out that rooms and guests were changed after the search. Even so, a browser automation could be built from it.
